name: agent-memory-runtime-m4a
title: Agent Memory Runtime M4A graph adoption decision
description: Evaluate one currently maintained local graph projection against the accepted G3R SQLite adjacency baseline and record a hash-bound G4A GO or NO-GO without changing SQLite authority.
scope: M4A only: decide whether a maintained local graph projection adds material structural retrieval value over the accepted SQLite adjacency baseline while preserving authority, lineage, purge, rebuild, fallback, privacy, latency, disk, and local operations; exclude vector, learning, and M6
creator: LienJack
notes: Completed evidence supports G4A NO-GO. SQLite adjacency remains active; relation_graph is unavailable for Context and default-off. M4B remains independent.
